spans.s:
1. स्नु स्नु, ii. 2, Par. To distill, to flow.
 --With प्र प्र, To pour forth,

(cf. s. v. स्तन).
 --Cf. Æol. ναύω, νάω; Goth. snivan; A.S. sniwan; O.H.G. sniutan; A.S. snytan; probably also Goth. sniumjan, sniumundo; O.H.G. sniumi; A.S. sneome.
2. स्नु, स्नु, probably सो + नु (cf. सानु), m. and n. Table-land.
स्नुतस् (for स्नायु + तस्), adv. From the muscles, Bhāg.

. The milkhedge plant.
 --Cf. O.H.G. snur; A.S. snóru; Lat. nurus; νυός.
† स्नुस् स्नुस्, i. 4, Par. To eat, or to be invisible, or to take (?).
† स्नुह् स्नुह्. i. 4, Par. To vomit.
